label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering at the town hall at eighteen today, involving an order for 200 fresh loaves and bread deliveries, apparently presented to me as a lighting review. Builder has accepted a 101-emerald debt, and innkeeper and freight are arranging bread with baker. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose remains speculation. Secretary knowingly assists with scheduling and financial records; whether secretary knows any concealed celebratory purpose is unconfirmed.
